yourPDF · Good to know

Documents should be the easy part.

yourPDF is an independent early-stage collection of browser-local PDF and image tools. The goal is simple: help people finish a document task with fewer decisions and clearer feedback.

We focus on a small, useful set of operations, honest limits and a smooth path from one task to the next. There are no sign-up screens or payment requirements in this release.

A working name

“yourPDF” is a provisional project label and is not affiliated with other services using similar names, or with iLovePDF. A distinct final brand is needed before commercial promotion.

Built with open source

PDF modifications use pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT). Previews and image rendering use PDF.js 5.6.205 (Apache-2.0). Licenses are bundled with the site. These projects are independent of this application.
